criteria.title: Integrate timerfd, eventfd, and monotonic deadlines where appropriate.

passages: timerfd_settime and read: absolute deadlines, disarm and accumulated uint64_t expirations

criteria.task: Integrate a nonblocking CLOCK_MONOTONIC timerfd and an eventfd counter in the original loop. Read exact counter widths, preserve accumulated counts, and handle EAGAIN without treating it as cancellation.
criteria.purpose: A notification descriptor carries one Boolean event per read.

knowledge: Retained T24.09 teaching passage and parent prerequisites
Active C17 semantics kept separate from POSIX/Linux, ISA, ABI and selected board contracts
artifacts: PR-T24-05 learner-owned implementation or diagnostic dossier
Predicted original fixture result before inspecting its expected data

reasoning: A notification descriptor carries one Boolean event per read. Refute this explanation with the smallest relevant state or execution.
State valid inputs, operation pre/postconditions, object ownership/lifetime and failure/publication boundaries for the specified mechanism.
Account for resource bounds and progress/complexity under the declared participant, storage and target assumptions. Name genuinely inapplicable costs instead of inventing them.

deliverables.D1: Pre-experiment prediction and causal argument addressing: A notification descriptor carries one Boolean event per read.
deliverables.D2: Integrate a nonblocking CLOCK_MONOTONIC timerfd and an eventfd counter in the original loop. Read exact counter widths, preserve accumulated counts, and handle EAGAIN without treating it as cancellation.
deliverables.D3: Exact commands or derivation steps, original inputs, observed outputs, a minimized disagreement and an independent control for this leaf. Retain unsupported-tool/target outcomes separately.
deliverables.D4: Replace periodic wakeups with a single earliest-deadline timer and derive rearm behavior when an earlier deadline is inserted.
